S50U26.today_summary: 1082.9 closed +3.8, a fourth gain in five sessions and 25.1 points off the 09-17 low of 1057.8, and now sits 2.9 points above the 1080 gamma flip instead of 0.7 below it. Net near-ATM GEX extended to +14,817 baht/point from +11,844, with 1,048 of today's 1,312 call lots (80%) traded at 1080-1100. P/C OI 2.43 still reads put-heavy, but P/C volume fell to 1.15 - the lowest since 09-17 - and total put OI shrank 354 lots on the day, so today's flow was call-side. ATM IV rose to 13.49% from 12.48%, within 0.05 of the 8-session high, the one datum arguing against the calm the gamma profile implies.
what_changed: Spot crossed the flip: 1082.9 is 2.9 points above 1080 against 0.7 below it yesterday, moving dealer hedging from knife-edge to dampening.
ATM GEX +14,817 from +11,844 (+25%), driven by +166 lots of new 1100 call OI and +59 at 1080.
ATM IV 13.49% from 12.48% (+1.01 points) even on a +3.8 up-day, widening 1 sigma to 9.21 points from 8.49.
Put OI 45,195 from 45,549 (-354 lots), with -180 at 1110 and -82 at 1050: protection closed into the rally, not added.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: 1070 max pain has not moved in 11 sessions while spot travelled 1070.7 on 09-16 to 1057.8 on 09-17 to 1082.9 today, so the structure is the constant and price is the variable. The decisive cross-day event is the gamma regime: ATM GEX ran -6,259 on 09-17 to +1,324, +1,952, +11,844 and +14,817, a short-to-long gamma flip that has strengthened for four consecutive sessions. The flip strike itself walked 1100 on 09-16 to 1000 on 09-18 to 1030 and now 1080, so the dampening band has climbed with price rather than capping it. The 1100 call wall has held its rank for eight sessions and thickened to 2,884 from 2,742, while near-money put support at 1050 thinned to 1,823 from 1,969 - the ceiling is firming faster than the floor. IV bottomed at 12.20% on 09-19 and has since expanded 1.29 points into 6 DTE, the only reading inconsistent with a clean pin.

strategies.name: Put credit spread 1060 / 1040
strategies.rationale: Spot 1082.9 sits 12.9 points above an unmoved 1070 max pain with +14,817 of ATM dealer gamma fading moves - the matrix's long-gamma pin above max pain - and the 1060 short strike is the 10d put band, 22.9 points (2.5 sigma) below spot.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20 points of width minus net credit received, at 200 baht per index point.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1060, which is under both the 1080 flip and 1070 max pain, where cumulative GEX of -2,703 turns dealer hedging pro-trend toward 1050.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1040 / 1050 put x 1100 / 1110 call
strategies.rationale: Both short strikes sit outside the live walls - 1,823 put OI at 1050 and 2,884 call OI at 1100 - and 6 DTE with long ATM gamma is the pinning row of the matrix; 1.01 points of IV expansion today argues for the smallest viable size.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 10 points per side minus total net credit; only one side can lose. Short-vol payoff is negative-skew, so size is the control, not strike selection.
strategies.invalidation: A close outside 1050-1100, or the 1100 call wall giving way on expanding volume and IV.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1080 / 1060
strategies.rationale: Cumulative GEX is -2,703 at 1070, so below the 1080 flip dealers amplify rather than fade a break, and 1 sigma of 9.21 points covers the entire distance from spot to the flip in a single session - defined-risk cover for the one case the short-vol structures lose on.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, bounded by the 20-point width.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1090 with ATM GEX holding above +14,000 - the pin holds and 6 sessions of theta decay the debit.

S50U26.prediction: 1070-1100 is the base case into the 09-29 expiry with 1080 as the magnet: +14,817 baht/point of ATM dealer gamma fades moves inside that band and 1 sigma is only 9.21 points. Bias is neutral with a mild upward tilt while spot holds above the 1080 flip, since the dampening shelf now sits above price rather than below it. A close below 1070 invalidates that - it re-enters short gamma and opens 1050 - and an ATM IV push through 13.54% on rising volume would be the max-pain-failure tell.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position is being recommended. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1070-1080 magnet as a tendency, not a guarantee. 16,430 of the 45,195 puts sit at the 910 strike on zero volume and a 47.8% quoted IV, so the 2.43 P/C OI ratio overstates live downside positioning. Defined risk is not risk-free - the capped max loss does occur - and macro or news flow can override the option structure outright.

S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Since 09-16 this series has added +758 put lots (+29%) and +479 call lots (+18%), so P/C OI drifted 0.98 to 1.07 while max pain never left 1070 - accumulation, not repositioning. The strongest single build is +151 lots at the 960 put, 122.4 points below spot and 68 lots traded there today, which is Protection-zone behaviour rather than a directional bet. The gamma flip walked 1150 to 1140 to 1130 as 1100-1150 call OI grew +277, yet cumulative GEX is still -1,293 at 1080, so the back month remains in the amplifying zone beneath its own flip. ATM IV slid from 12.95% to 12.40% (-0.55) across the window while the front month rose to 13.49%, so 97-day protection got cheaper exactly as demand for it built - which is why a debit structure fits here and a credit one does not. The caveat is liveness: only 208 call and 250 put lots traded across the whole chain today, so under Vol2Vol every wall in this series is provisional.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1040 / 990
strategies.rationale: A Protection zone with neutral, thin dealer gamma and 12.40% IV near the low of its range is the matrix's cheap-insurance row; 1040 is the 25d put band and 990 the 10d, so the structure buys the flat part of the smile (+0.04 at 25d) and sells the rich tail (+3.05 at 10d).
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid; the spread's maximum value is the 50-point width at 200 baht per index point.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1100 on rising call OI, which clears the series' only real call wall (505 lots) and leaves 97 days of theta working against the debit.

S50Z26.prediction: 1070-1100 also contains the back month, but for a different reason than the front: at 97 DTE with 8.46 points of daily sigma, 1070 max pain is an accounting anchor rather than a magnet. Bias is neutral with a protective tilt, because 29% put-OI growth in five sessions says the marginal back-month buyer is paying for downside rather than chasing upside. A sustained move above the 1100 call wall would invalidate that read; a break of 1040 on real volume would confirm it and activate the -1,293 cumulative GEX that sits below the 1130 flip.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position is being recommended. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery and the hedging mechanics that pin price are weaker than for share-settled single stocks; at 97 DTE the 1070 anchor is a tendency at best. Liquidity is the binding constraint: 208 call and 250 put lots traded across the entire chain today, so quoted IVs and every wall here are provisional under the Vol2Vol filter. Defined risk is not risk-free - a debit spread can lose 100% of the premium paid.
